answer: Simultaneous liveness pulses: at random moments a beacon sends one pulse to every registered agent at once, each carrying a memory-hard puzzle needing 4 GB of RAM for 2 seconds, due back within 3 seconds. Identities cannot take turns on one box, so 100 fakes need 400 GB of ferrous rack memory idling for surprise checks, a cost linear per clone that cannot be shared. Like a zephyr, the pulse comes unannounced, so renting capacity just in time fails.
